physical_qualification: Pending for .3. Earlier .1/.2 device results qualify only their exact bytes.
consumer_role: native-build-input-only; consumer compiles its own JNI bridge
other_native_entries: Byte-identical to provider; all eight libmpv/FFmpeg libraries are replaced for each shipped ABI. All x86 entries remain provider bytes; consumers exclude x86. Validate imports against retained dependencies and API-26 stubs.
ffmpeg_configuration: Unmodified pinned FFmpeg 8.1.3 source; existing GPL/version3 provider options plus --enable-muxer=spdif after --disable-muxers. No encoder, device or filter is enabled. All seven FFmpeg shared libraries come from the same fresh per-ABI build.
build_provenance: 0.41.0-jellyscope.3 requires one fresh scripts/build-native.sh run for all three ABIs in new build/output directories. All libmpv and FFmpeg libraries come from that run. No prior candidate binaries are reused; no byte-reproducibility or runtime acceptance claim.
corresponding_source: per-ABI mpv-modified-source.tar.gz produced by the same fresh build and carried unchanged into the separate source offer, matching the per-ABI modified_source_sha256 in the packaged bundle.json; scripts/package-aar.py records there every hashed build output (libraries, modified mpv source and FFmpeg configuration/registration records) from that build. FFmpeg is the recorded unmodified commit plus the packaged controlling build scripts, with one unmodified FFmpeg source archive in the source offer rather than per ABI; per-ABI patch series, crossfile, Meson options and FFmpeg source revision accompany each ABI there
